packageRules.description: GitHub Actions minor and patch SHA bumps (grouped). Actions are pinned to commit digests org-wide; see qnophq/qnop ADR-0017.
GitHub Actions major updates — separate PRs for deliberate review.
Docker base-image digest updates (grouped). Images are pinned to digests; see qnophq/qnop ADR-0017.

npm major updates — one PR per package (no grouping). Bundling unrelated majors regularly ships broken lockfiles when one package still pins an incompatible peer. Per-package PRs let each major be reviewed and merged independently.

Pin npm dependency versions exactly (no ^/~ ranges). qnophq repos ship application code, not libraries — every CI build, Docker image, and dev clone should resolve to identical bytes. Pinning turns every patch into an explicit Renovate PR with a real changelog instead of silent lockfile drift. Applies to dependencies and devDependencies only — peer- and bundled-deps keep their ranges.
